name: Alex Jie Yang
intro: I study how knowledge, people, and research teams shape scientific innovation. My research connects science of science, network science, and computational social science.

topics.title: Scientific innovation
topics.description: Measuring novelty, disruption, and breakthroughs in science and technology.

topics.title: Teams & collaboration
topics.description: Understanding how team structures, diversity, and collaboration relate to innovation.

topics.title: Knowledge & networks
topics.description: Mapping knowledge spaces, citation networks, and the evolution of scientific ideas.

reviewing: Nature Human Behaviour, npj Artificial Intelligence, Journal of the Association for Information Science and Technology, Information Processing & Management, Journal of Informetrics, Scientometrics, Journal of Information Science, Expert Systems With Applications, Archives of Computational Methods in Engineering, Computational and Mathematical Organization Theory, Journal of Global Entrepreneurship Research, Journal of Technology Transfer, Computers in Human Behavior Reports, etc.
